summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.77/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.77 a gallon across Wisconsin as of November 10, 2026, according to GasBuddy — the lowest since September 7. AAA figures put the statewide average 32¢ lower than a week ago, 27¢ lower than a month ago, and $1.04 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Sheboygan ($3.54) and the highest in Rhinelander ($4.06).
